newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FORECAST-Russia sees 3,250 trln rbls GDP in 2000.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Russia sees 3,250 trln rbls GDP in 2000.

text.p: The Economy Ministry expects Russia's gross domestic product to grow to 3,250 trillion roubles ($560 billion) in 2000 from 2,550-2,600 trillion roubles forecast for 1997, a Finance Ministry official said on Tuesday.

Finance Ministry Macroeconomic Department Head Anton Siluanov quoted Economy Ministry forecasts as saying GDP, in constant inflation-adjusted roubles, would rise to 2,750 trillion roubles in 1998 and 3,000 trillion roubles in 1999.
Siluanov told Reuters the Finance Ministry endorsed the Economy Ministry forecast.
In the first five months of 1997 GDP slipped 0.2 percent year on year.
Siluanov said the Finance Ministry forecast the budget deficit for 2000 would be 3.5 percent after 5.4 percent in 1997. Both figures are to international standards, he said.
He also said the Finance Ministry forecast the 1998 deficit would be 4.6 percent and the 1999 deficit to be 4.4 percent.
The Economy Ministry forecasts three percent in consumer inflation in 2000, down from the 1997 forecast of 11.8 percent, Siluanov said.
Inflation in 1998 inflation will be five percent and 1999 inflation will be four percent, he forecast.
